name: GET /api/leadflow/analytics/attribution - evidence, not reconstruction
description:
Campaign, ad, creative and UTM performance grouped from columns stamped at intake (b7eceb85-6dd9-4335-b950-ff0cf1de6822#AC1). EVIDENCE-BASED RATHER THAN RECONSTRUCTED: the attribution fields travel with the lead from intake to closed-won, so this is a GROUP BY over facts recorded at the time rather than a guess assembled later from timestamps and campaign windows. That difference is what makes a number marketing can defend.

BOTH THE ORIGINAL AND THE LATEST SOURCE SURVIVE, in separate columns. leads.source is the ORIGINAL and never moves; latest_source is its own column added for this task, because overwriting the first on a later touch is exactly how a paid channel takes credit for an organic lead.

THE DERIVATION IS REGISTERED WITH sdk-analytics so its lineage is inspectable (b7eceb85-6dd9-4335-b950-ff0cf1de6822#AC4). A disputed attribution number is then followed back to its inputs rather than defended by assertion; when the registration cannot be made the response says so rather than implying a lineage ref that does not exist.

QA: measured live over 90 days.

testCases.name: Attribution rows carry both original and latest source, with a lineage note
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
